name: com.alltcgapi/mcp
title: alltcgapi
description: Cards, sets, sealed products and current Cardmarket (EUR) and TCGplayer (USD) prices for 19 TCGs.

environmentVariables.name: ALLTCG_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for alltcgapi.com (atcg_live_…). Every tool needs it; atcg_get_coverage still reports price coverage without it.

environmentVariables.name: ALLTCG_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://api.alltcgapi.com.
